svg.font-family: Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: Secure AWS Landing Zone & Multi-Account Governance - Architecture
Only components implemented in the project. Security groups and NACLs are configured; no compute is deployed.
Users sign in through SSO with MFA
Permission sets grant access to accounts
security-audit assumes a role in dev
Org trail and Flow Logs go to log-archive
SG chain: sg-alb -> sg-app -> sg-db (rules only).
Control Tower: conceptual comparison in report.
Prod VPC is built with Terraform.
Route tables: public -> IGW | app -> NAT (temporary) | data -> local only
GuardDuty / Security Hub admin: security-audit. Config aggregator: management.
AWS Config stores to its own bucket in each account.
